offence_note: Causing disturbance, assaulting police officer, assault, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: I am going to impose a conditional sentence order for a period of six months.
systemic_quote: But taking into account that he is a young aboriginal male with a serious alcohol problem which results in him committing criminal offences while he is drunk; it is intergenerational alcoholism in the family.
note: Appeal dismissed; concurrent 6-month CSOs plus 6 months probation consecutive; residential treatment at supervisor direction.

offence_note: Sexual molestation of stepdaughter over three years
sentence_quote: The sentence is varied to two years less a day in custody.
note: Sentence raised from 9 months; about three months already in custody; probation order stands.

offence_note: Theft of iPad under $5,000 from wheelchair user
sentence_quote: I would grant Mr. Ned leave to appeal, but dismiss his appeal from his sentence.
systemic_quote: The sentencing judge took into account Mr. Ned's difficult upbringing and his aboriginal background
note: 12 months less about 6.5 months remand leaves 5 months; co-offender Lagimodiere not sentenced here.

offence_note: Aggravated assault of a prostitute with a transformer
sentence_quote: A sentence of one year imprisonment plus three years probation is substituted for the term of imprisonment of four years.

offence_note: Sexual interference of a child under 16

note: Sexual assault count conditionally stayed; SOIRA 20 years; s.161 limited to 100 metres from victim.

offence_note: Impaired driving causing bodily harm to two people
sentence_quote: Mr. Leung, I sentence you to 90 days to be served intermittently.
note: Intermittent sentence served on Fridays; concurrent on counts; prohibition under s. 259(2).

offence_note: Offence not shown; knowledge and control of property
sentence_quote: There is no basis on which we can interfere with the sentence.
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed; sentence and offence not described.

offence_note: Firearm offence s.95(1); drug trafficking possession by co-offenders
co_offenders: Lewis: 4 years 6 months; McInnis: time served
sentence_quote: The sentence of this Court is that you be incarcerated for a period of three and one half years to run consecutive to any sentence that you are presently serving.

note: Custody set aside; probation 12 months with 100 hours community service; mischief restitution amount not shown.
